en: A monochrome (tinted) historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilltop town dominated by a large complex of multi‑storey buildings and towers, including a prominent round defensive tower on the right and baroque‑style roofs and spires in the center. Smaller houses and greenery spread down the slope in the foreground. The caption "Elbogen." is printed in red at the lower left, with the publisher credit "Brück & Sohn, Meissen." and the number "1035" in small red type at the bottom edge.
